description: This file defines JSON converter classes for converting between JSON objects and Java collections (List and Map). It includes classes for JSON to List, JSON to Map, List to JSON, and Map to JSON conversions, implementing a ConverterLoader interface.

classes.name: JSONConverters
classes.description: Main class that loads JSON conversion classes and implements ConverterLoader.

classes.name: JSONToMap
classes.description: Converts JSON to a Map<String, Object>.

classes.name: MapToJSON
classes.description: Converts a Map<String, Object> to JSON.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts JSON to List or Map, or converts List or Map to JSON, with exception handling.
